title: DOT-07: DOT priority letter names milestones for information-centric drone airspace
summary: GAO identifies specific FAA milestones for future information-centric drone airspace as a current priority action. Phase 56P publishes the letter-named action while preserving its local identity boundary and open-status limit.
key_findings: Exact letter action: DOT-07 — FAA should develop and implement specific milestones for integrating drones into a future information-centric airspace.
Status period: Open priority portfolio as of June 2026; letter dated June 23, 2026.
Identity boundary: FTFN key DOT-07 identifies the action text in GAO-26-109050; it is not a GAO Recommendations Database number.
Continuation rule: Recheck the GAO Recommendations Database or the next DOT priority letter for an exact identifier or status change tied to this action.
why_it_matters: The record converts portfolio-level visibility into an inspectable named action without claiming implementation or importing an unsupported database identifier.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves letter, subject, local action key, status period, and continuation identity.
Keeps priority designation, implementation, closure, operating outcome, and realized benefit distinct.
evidence_limits: The letter names the action but does not provide its underlying GAO Recommendations Database number or a complete DOT portfolio inventory.
Open priority designation does not prove non-performance, implementation progress, closure, or operating outcome.
The local action key is an FTFN reference and must not be presented as a GAO-assigned recommendation number.
No ranking, composite, readiness score, performance rate, value estimate, or causal claim is supported.
